LKH3SamplerSettings.description: Sampling recipe for the long video sampler; connect to the sampler's sampler_settings input to override its widget defaults.

0.name: sampler settings
0.tooltip: Connect to the long video sampler's sampler_settings input.

video_vae.name: Video VAE
video_vae.tooltip: Video VAE (link from the MiniMaxH3模型设置 node's 视频 VAE output). Falls back to the name picked in the settings when unconnected.

audio_vae.name: Audio VAE
audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE (link from the MiniMaxH3模型设置 node's 音频 VAE output). Falls back to the name picked in the settings when unconnected.

0.name: AV Latent
0.tooltip: Whole-video packed AV latent with lk_layout metadata. Chain through AV潜空间放大 + a downstream sampler chain for the HD second pass, or decode with the AV 解码 node.

1.name: conditioning
1.tooltip: First executed shot's positive conditioning — feed into a comfy BasicGuider for downstream second-pass chains.

LKH3AVUpscale.description: Spatially upscales the video part of the packed AV latent for the HD second pass; audio and layout metadata pass through unchanged. Chain: long video sampler av_latent -> this node -> long video sampler refine_latent.

av_latent.name: av_latent
av_latent.tooltip: Packed AV latent from the long video sampler's av_latent output.

upscale_method.name: upscale method
upscale_method.tooltip: Interpolation applied to the video latent (and its mask).

scale_by.name: scale by
scale_by.tooltip: Spatial scale factor. The default 2.0 takes the 0.5MP base canvas to the H3 trained maximum (~1920x1088). The second pass costs roughly scale^2 more compute per token than the first pass.

upscale_in_segments.name: Upscale in segments
upscale_in_segments.tooltip: Upscale one layout segment (per shot) at a time to bound the VRAM peak on long videos. Chunks are temporal, non-overlapping and the interpolation is frame-local, so the assembled result is identical to a whole-tensor upscale.

0.name: av_latent
0.tooltip: Upscaled packed AV latent; feed the downstream HD sampler chain (双钟采样 + BasicGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced).

LKH3Settings.description: Shared MiniMax H3 model/canvas settings; connect to the shots node.

0.name: settings
0.tooltip: Connect to the MiniMaxH3 Shot Storyboard node's settings input.

1.name: Video VAE
1.tooltip: Selected video VAE as a link — feed the long-video sampler's 视频 VAE input or the AV 解码 node.

2.name: Audio VAE
2.tooltip: Selected audio VAE as a link — feed the long-video sampler's 音频 VAE input or the AV 解码 node.

LKH3Shot.description: One long-video shot: duration, prompt, first/last frame and reference media sockets. Output connects to the MiniMaxH3 Shot Merger node.

0.name: shot
0.tooltip: Connect to a MiniMaxH3 Shot Merger slot (shots 1-8).

LKH3Shots.description: Collects ordered MiniMaxH3 Shot nodes with the model settings and emits the segment plan for the sampler.

0.name: segments
0.tooltip: Long-video segment plan; connect to the long video sampler.

LKH3DualClockSampler.description: Patches the model with the MiniMax H3 AV dual-clock model sampling and emits MODEL / SAMPLER / SIGMAS for comfy-core BasicGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced chains (T8 style).

av_latent.name: AV Latent
av_latent.tooltip: Nested AV latent the contract is built for (layout/keyframe patches and the audio clock check). Feed the long-video sampler's av_latent or the upscaled second-pass latent.

0.name: model
0.tooltip: Model patched with the AV dual-clock / FLOW_AV sampling — feed a comfy-core BasicGuider's model input.

1.name: sampler
1.tooltip: Standard SAMPLER primitive — feed SamplerCustomAdvanced's sampler input.

2.name: sigmas
2.tooltip: Full schedule (sigma[0]=max -> sigma[-1]=0) — feed SamplerCustomAdvanced's sigmas input.

LKH3AVDecode.description: Decodes the packed AV latent into frames and audio; also exposes the split video/audio latent halves for custom downstream chains.

av_latent.name: AV Latent
av_latent.tooltip: Nested AV latent from the long-video sampler (or a downstream sampler chain).

video_vae.name: Video VAE
video_vae.tooltip: Video VAE (link from the MiniMaxH3模型设置 node).

audio_vae.name: Audio VAE
audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE (link from the MiniMaxH3模型设置 node).

0.name: Frames
0.tooltip: All decoded frames (one IMAGE per frame).

2.name: Video Latent
2.tooltip: Video half of the latent (with layout metadata).
